settings.notes: daily_calorie_goal and daily_protein_goal_g are optional — set them by telling Claude e.g. 'set my daily calorie goal to 2200' or 'set my protein goal to 160'. protein_goal was set using a bodyweight-based heuristic (0.8-1g per lb) for lifting-while-in-a-deficit, at ~189lb — recalculate if bodyweight changes meaningfully. timezone controls how dates/times are stamped on entries — tell Claude your timezone to set it once.

recipes.name: Sausage egg casserole (1 square)
recipes.notes: Full casserole (~2,500 cal) cut into 16 equal squares. Ingredients: 10 XL eggs, 1 lb breakfast sausage, 1/2 cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt, 3/4 cup shredded cheese, 1.5 cups frozen bell peppers, 2-4 tbsp pickled jalapenos, 3 cloves garlic, 1/2 tsp butter. Per square: ~11-12g fat, ~2g carbs.

recipes.name: Trader Joe's Teeny Tiny Avocado (1 whole)
recipes.notes: Per whole tiny avocado: ~11g fat, ~6g carbs, ~5g fiber.

recipes.name: Egg casserole for lunch (standard)
recipes.notes: Shortcut = 3 sausage egg casserole squares (465 cal, 31.5g protein) + 1 Trader Joe's Teeny Tiny Avocado (120 cal, 1.5g protein). Approx macros: ~46g fat, ~12g carbs, ~5-6g fiber. Unless Deano specifies otherwise, 'egg casserole for lunch' always means this exact combo.
